none: PAS FindID 997235: Lin-786E59: Roman nummus of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17, Lyons mint, issue of 330-331, RIC vol. 7 page 138 no. 241. Obverse description: Helmeted bust laureate left with spear over shoulder, mantled. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Reverse description: Victory with shield and spear on prow advancing left. In exergue: PLG. Diameter: 14.01 mm; Thickness: 1.73 mm; Weight: 1.15g die axis: 12
